title: 第五章 双生相逢似曾相识第六章 暗影窥伺土水共鸣
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 晨光刺破厚重的云层，温柔洒落整座琉光星冕综合学园。
经历过昨夜暗黑结界倾覆、灵力激荡的彻夜动荡，这座伫立在城市腹地的顶级学园，终于彻底褪去了深夜的阴翳与寒凉。漫天残存的深渊戾气尽数被净化消融，萦绕在天地间的凛冽肃杀气息悄然散尽，取而代之的是清晨独有的澄澈通透与鲜活暖意。
澄澈如洗的湛蓝天幕之上，流云舒展散漫，温柔的朝阳悬于天际，金红交织的柔光层层铺展，掠过错落精致的学园楼宇、青葱繁茂的林荫绿化带、开阔整洁的塑胶操场，将昨夜战乱遗留的所有暗沉阴冷彻底驱散。
微风轻柔拂过大地，裹挟着草木新芽的清甜、晨间露珠的温润，漫过高中部与初中部的每一寸土地，唤醒了沉睡整夜的学园烟火，奏响了崭新一日的校园序曲。
清晨六点四十分，琉光星冕综合学园全员早自习预备铃声准时响彻四方。
清脆悠扬的铃声穿透层层楼宇，回荡在空旷的操场与静谧的楼道之间，为原本安然静谧的校园，添上了鲜活规整的秩序感。沉寂一夜的学园瞬间苏醒，络绎不绝的学子身着统一的渐变制式校服，步履轻盈地穿梭在各个学部的廊道之间，奔赴各自的教室准备早自习。
高中部的教学楼依旧残留着昨夜激战的细微痕迹。
高二（1）班的教室玻璃尽数更换崭新，倾覆歪斜的桌椅全部归位整齐，散落满地的书本碎屑、灵力碎片被智能清扫系统彻底清理干净，墙面斑驳的裂痕经过精密修缮，恢复了平整光洁的原貌。若非空气中还残留着一丝极淡极淡的灵力焦灼余味，无人能看出这间普通的教室，昨夜曾经历过一场濒临湮灭的顶级对决。
天野凛星早早抵达教学楼，并未直接走进教室。行至廊道僻静处时，一道熟悉的身影迎面走来，正是藤咲若织。
她一身标准精致的浅红柔赤渐变校服温婉雅致、利落大方。奶白色定制衬衫挺括整洁，领口系着细腻的红调丝绒渐变领结，胸前校徽旁的弓矢暗纹精致隐秘，外搭浅红渐变修身小西装，袖口柔赤渐变纹路细腻流畅，银线暗纹在晨光下若隐若现。一头红调渐变长卷发柔顺披散肩头，自深红轻盈晕染为柔赤，发尾泛着淡淡的赤焰柔光，眉眼温润通透、恬淡安然，依旧是平日里从容端庄的模样。
两人停下脚步，周遭少有往来的同学，恰好适合简单交谈。
藤咲若织率先开口，语气平和坦然，没有半分迂回：“天野凛星，有几句话，我想单独和你说。”
天野凛星微微一怔，随即颔首：“请讲。”
“我知道你的真实身份。”藤咲若织目光坦然地望向他，一字一句清晰说道，“你就是六位星冕守护者之中，执掌冰与圣光力量的冰之守护者。”
直白的话语落下，天野凛星眼底掠过一丝讶异。他三年前亲历王族覆灭的浩劫，此后一直刻意隐藏守护者的身份，在校内始终以普通学生自居，从未向外透露过半分相关信息。
“不必意外。”藤咲若织轻轻摇头，语气诚恳，“数次灵力交锋、并肩应对暗影深渊的势力，你的力量特质与战斗方式我早已辨认清楚。我不会将这件事宣扬出去，你大可放心。”
她顿了顿，目光望向远方的教学楼，神色添了几分凝重：“如今暗影深渊蠢蠢欲动，危机从未真正散去。六位守护者尚且处于集结阶段，身份暴露只会徒增风险。守护这座学园、抵挡深渊势力的侵袭，是我们共同的责任。”
天野凛星收敛心绪，打量着眼前的少女，心中满是警惕与疑惑，却并未追问对方的底细：“多谢你愿意保密。眼下晨间事务繁多，想必你也要前往学生会工作，我们就此别过，往后若遇变故，彼此多加照拂便好。”
“理应如此。”
简短交谈过后，二人各自分开。藤咲若织转身走向学生会办公室，着手处理晨间各项工作；天野凛星则迈步走入高二（1）班教室，回归学生身份，静坐下来。
脖颈间细巧银链悬挂的鎏金星刃吊坠静静贴合肌肤，微凉的金属质感时刻警醒着他深藏心底的守护宿命。三年前那场浩劫的画面依旧清晰烙印在脑海中，家园倾覆、族人陨落的伤痛从未淡去。
昨夜天台彻夜的全域排查与灵力净化，让他彻底确认学园表层已无显性深渊隐患，但后山禁忌密林深处的裂隙依旧存在，深渊之主蛰伏不出、杀意暗藏，如同悬在所有人头顶的一柄利刃，随时可能掀起新的风暴。
一夜调息静养，他体内被深渊王权神力震伤的经脉肌理已然修复大半，冰圣双本源的灵力彻底趋于稳定，损耗的力量尽数补足，唯独心底的戒备与凝重，丝毫未曾消减。
王族与生俱来的极致感知力，时刻笼罩整座学园的天地气场，捕捉着每一缕灵力波动、每一丝异常气息，不敢有半分松懈。
昨夜两大顶级光明王族本源的共振激荡，唤醒了初中部两股特殊的气息。他清楚这是沧澜星土神域的双生继承者，三年前神域沦陷后，二人被施以禁术封印记忆与本源，拆分流落至此，如今只是两名懵懂的普通少女，对过往宿命一无所知。
两股微弱却纯粹古老的本源气息，此刻依旧若有若无地飘荡在学园的空气之中，干净温柔、与世无争，却带着跨越三年离散的厚重羁绊，悄然牵动着天地间的守护轨迹。
天野凛星能够清晰感知到这两股同源共生、互补相依的特殊灵力，上古神域典籍中记载着沧澜双生守护的过往，他知晓二人遭遇，却无意贸然打扰。
“学园之中，沉睡的双生本源终于开始躁动了。”
少年垂眸凝思，笔尖轻轻停顿在书页之上，清冷低沉的嗓音在空旷的教室中轻轻响起。
晨光落在他澄澈的眼眸之中，映出层层叠叠的探究与凝重。
“记忆与力量仍被封禁，她们尚且不知自己的身世，也不懂潜藏的危机。”
他细细感知着两股灵力的特质，一水一风、一土一金，温柔厚重、灵动坚韧，完美互补、紧密纠缠，是世间极为罕见的双生共生本源。
“三年浩劫落幕，蛰伏至今，宿命的轨迹终究还是开始转动了。”
天野凛星缓缓抬眸，望向窗外遥遥相对的初中部教学楼，眼底深思愈发浓重。
暗樱女王挣脱万年封印，三年前掀起浩劫覆灭六大王族，如今她的爪牙再度现世，目标必然会瞄准这些力量尚未觉醒、毫无防备的继承者。
他心中无比清楚，沧澜双生本源的苏醒绝非偶然，这是光明与黑暗再度交锋后，天地灵力产生的必然回响。散落人间的王族血脉接连被唤醒，属于六位星冕守护者的征程，正在一步步缓缓拉开完整序幕。
只是此刻双生少女记忆全无、力量沉睡，对自身背负的宿命、彼此纠缠的羁绊、即将到来的危机，全然一无所知。
他不会主动探寻、不会强行惊扰。每个人的宿命都有专属的觉醒时机，强行干预、贸然窥探，只会打乱天命轨迹，酿成未知的凶险。他能做的，便是守好眼前方寸安宁，筑牢学园的光明屏障，静待宿命自然流转、静待伙伴宿命归位。
与此同时，高中部学生会办公室。
content_en:
The morning light pierced through the thick clouds and gently fell on the entire Ryukwang Star Crown Comprehensive Academy.
After experiencing the night-long turmoil of the overthrow of the dark barrier and the surge of spiritual energy last night, this top-notch academy standing in the hinterland of the city has finally completely shed the gloom and coldness of the night. All the remaining abyssal aura that filled the sky was purified and dissolved, and the cold and murderous aura lingering between heaven and earth quietly dissipated, replaced by the unique clarity and fresh warmth of the morning.
Above the clear blue sky, the flowing clouds spread out, and the gentle morning sun hung in the sky. The golden and red soft light spread layer by layer, passing over the exquisite school buildings, the lush green belts, and the open and clean plastic playground, completely dispelling all the gloom and coldness left by last night's war.
The breeze blew gently across the earth, carrying the sweetness of the new buds of the vegetation and the warmth of the morning dew. It spread over every inch of the high school and junior high schools, awakening the school fireworks that had been sleeping all night, and played the prelude to a new day on campus.
At 6:40 in the morning, the morning self-study preparation bell rang for all members of Ryuguang Xingmian Comprehensive Academy on time.
The crisp and melodious bells penetrated through the buildings, echoing in the empty playground and quiet corridors, adding a lively and regular sense of order to the originally peaceful and quiet campus. The academy, which had been silent for a night, suddenly woke up. An endless stream of students, dressed in uniforms with uniform gradient uniforms, walked lightly through the corridors of various departments, rushing to their respective classrooms to prepare for morning self-study.
The teaching building of the high school still retains subtle traces of the fierce battle last night.
All the glass in the classroom of Class 1, Grade 2, has been replaced with new ones. All the overturned and crooked tables and chairs have been put back in order. The scattered book debris and spiritual energy fragments on the floor have been thoroughly cleaned up by the intelligent cleaning system. The mottled cracks on the wall have been precisely repaired and restored to their original smooth and smooth appearance. If it weren't for the faint aftertaste of spiritual anxiety still lingering in the air, no one would have been able to tell that this ordinary classroom had experienced a top-notch duel on the verge of annihilation last night.
Amano Rinxei arrived at the teaching building early and did not enter the classroom directly. When they reached a secluded part of the corridor, a familiar figure came towards them, it was Fujisaki Wakaori.
She is wearing a standard and exquisite school uniform of light red and soft red gradient, which is gentle, elegant, neat and elegant. The cream-white custom-made shirt is crisp and neat, with a delicate red-toned velvet gradient bow tie at the collar. The bow and arrow pattern next to the school emblem on the chest is exquisite and hidden. It is worn with a slim-fitting light red gradient suit. The soft red gradient pattern on the cuffs is delicate and smooth, and the dark silver lines are faintly visible in the morning light. She has long curly hair with gradient red tones flowing smoothly around her shoulders. It has been lightly dyed from deep red to soft red. The ends of her hair are glowing with a faint red flame. Her brows and eyes are warm and transparent, calm and peaceful. She still looks calm and dignified on weekdays.
The two of them stopped, and the few classmates around them were just suitable for a simple conversation.
Fujisaki Wakaori spoke first, with a calm and calm tone, without any circumlocution: "Amano Rinsei, there are a few words I want to say to you alone."
Amano Rinxing was startled for a moment, then nodded: "Please speak."
"I know your true identity." Fujisaki Wakaori looked at him calmly and said clearly every word, "You are the Ice Guardian among the six Star Crown Guardians, who controls the power of ice and holy light."
After the straightforward words fell, a trace of surprise flashed in Amano Rinxing's eyes. He personally experienced the catastrophe of the destruction of the royal family three years ago. Since then, he has deliberately hidden his identity as a guardian. He has always regarded himself as an ordinary student in the school and has never revealed any relevant information to the outside world.
"You..."
"There is no need to be surprised." Fujisaki Wakaori shook his head gently and said in a sincere tone, "After several spiritual confrontations and working side by side to deal with the forces of the Shadow Abyss, I have already clearly identified your strength, characteristics and fighting style. I will not publicize this matter, so you can rest assured."
She paused and looked at the teaching building in the distance, her expression becoming more solemn: "Now the Shadow Abyss is ready to move, and the crisis has never really dissipated. The six guardians are still in the assembly stage, and exposing their identities will only increase the risk. It is our common responsibility to protect this academy and resist the invasion of the forces of the abyss."
Amano Rinxing gathered his thoughts and looked at the girl in front of him. His heart was full of vigilance and doubts, but he did not ask for the other party's details: "Thank you for your willingness to keep it secret. There are many things in the morning now, and you must also go to work in the student union. Let's say goodbye. If anything happens in the future, we can take care of each other."
"As it should be."
After a brief conversation, the two separated. Fujisaki Wakaori turned and walked to the student union office and started to deal with various morning tasks; Amano Rinxei walked into the classroom of Grade 2 (1), returned to his identity as a student, and sat down quietly.
The gilt star blade pendant hanging from a delicate silver chain around his neck fit quietly against his skin, and its cool metal texture always reminded him of the guardian destiny deep in his heart. The image of the catastrophe three years ago is still clearly imprinted in my mind, and the pain of the overthrow of my home and the loss of my tribe has never faded away.
Last night's all-night investigation and spiritual purification on the rooftop allowed him to completely confirm that there were no obvious hidden dangers of the abyss on the surface of the academy. However, the cracks deep in the forbidden forest in the back mountain still existed. The Lord of the Abyss was dormant and had hidden murderous intent. Like a sharp blade hanging above everyone's head, he could set off a new storm at any time.
After a night of rest and relaxation, most of the meridians in his body that were damaged by the power of the abyss have been repaired. The spiritual power of the Ice Saint twin sources has completely stabilized, and all the lost power has been replenished. Only the vigilance and solemnity in his heart have not diminished at all.
The ultimate sense of perception inherent in the royal family always envelopes the aura of the entire academy, capturing every fluctuation of spiritual power and every trace of abnormal breath, without daring to relax even a little bit.
Last night, the resonance of the two top light royal families awakened two special auras in the junior high school. He knew that these were the twin successors of the Canglan Planet Earth God Realm. After the fall of the God Realm three years ago, the two were subjected to forbidden techniques to seal their memories and origins. They were separated and lived here. Now they are just two ignorant ordinary girls who know nothing about their past fate.
Two weak but pure ancient original auras are still floating in the air of the school at this moment. They are clean, gentle and uncontested, but with a heavy bond that spans three years of separation, they quietly affect the guardianship between heaven and earth.
Amano Rinxing could clearly perceive the two special spiritual powers that came from the same source, coexisted and complemented each other. The past of the guardians of the Canglan twins was recorded in the ancient divine domain scriptures. He knew what happened to the two, but had no intention of disturbing them rashly.
"In the academy, the dormant twin origins finally began to stir."
The young man lowered his eyes and meditated, the tip of his pen paused lightly on the page, and a cold and low voice sounded softly in the empty classroom.
The morning light fell in his clear eyes, reflecting layers of exploration and solemnity.
"The memory and power are still blocked. They don't know their origins yet, and they don't understand the hidden dangers."
He carefully felt the characteristics of the two spiritual powers, one water and one wind, one earth and one metal. They were gentle and thick, agile and tough, perfectly complementary and closely intertwined. They were the origin of twin symbiosis that was extremely rare in the world.
"Three years of catastrophe have come to an end, and the trajectory of fate, which has been dormant to this day, finally begins to turn."
Amano Rinxing slowly raised his eyes and looked out the window at the junior high school teaching building facing away from him, his eyes becoming more thoughtful.
Queen Dark Sakura broke free from the ten thousand-year seal and caused a catastrophe three years ago to destroy the six royal families. Now her minions have reappeared, and their targets will inevitably be aimed at these unsuspecting successors who have not yet awakened their power.
He knew extremely well in his heart that the awakening of Canglan's twin origins was no accident. It was the inevitable echo of the spiritual power of heaven and earth after light and darkness clashed again. The bloodlines of the royal family scattered in the world are being awakened one after another, and the journey of the six Star Crown Guardians is slowly beginning to complete step by step.
It's just that at this moment, the twin girls have no memory, their power is sleeping, and they have no idea about their fate, their entangled bonds, and the upcoming crisis.
He will not take the initiative to explore or disturb by force. Everyone's destiny has an exclusive opportunity to awaken. Forcible intervention and hasty prying will only disrupt the trajectory of destiny and lead to unknown dangers. All he can do is to keep the peace in front of him, build a bright barrier of the academy, and wait for fate to flow naturally and wait for the destiny of his partners to return.
At the same time, the high school student union office.
title_en: Chapter 5: Twins meet and feel familiar Chapter 6: Shadow peeks at the resonance of earth and water
